purpose: Deterministic low-entropy precommitment schema for blind retrospective HD transit tests
reveal_rule: After the user's free report, enumerate every mechanically qualifying event in the committed onset minute and every allowed direction/domain combination, serialize each candidate exactly under canonical_json, and SHA-256 each candidate. Reveal/score only if exactly one candidate matches the stored commitment hash. Zero matches = COMMITMENT-MISMATCH. More than one match = COMMITMENT-AMBIGUOUS.

scoring_rule.HIT: The free report independently contains the committed directional change in the committed domain relative to the comparator.
scoring_rule.PARTIAL: The report contains a weaker or mixed version of the committed change.
scoring_rule.MISS: The report is sufficiently clear and lacks or contradicts the committed change.
scoring_rule.UNUSABLE_RECALL: The user cannot reconstruct the interval well enough to score.

notes: Never hash free-form prediction prose in v2.
Do not expose the event/direction/domain codes before the user's free report.
Base micro-transitions are excluded from ordinary tests.
Tone behavioral predictions remain experimental extensions unless separately validated.
